mechanisms.decisive_claim: There is a weight-nondecreasing coordinate compression sending every admissible exponent-lattice set to a down-set while preserving the predecessor constraint.
mechanisms.kill_test: Enumerate or solve small exponent boxes and apply every one-coordinate downward shift; kill on a newly created forbidden triple or loss of reciprocal weight.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Every weighted squarefree-cube optimum is equivalent to selecting supports from at most two low layers after a coordinate order is fixed.
mechanisms.kill_test: Solve weighted cubes for heterogeneous primes through k=12 and kill if every optimum necessarily uses three or more separated support sizes.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: A fibre induction adjoining one prime coordinate loses only the local prime-block factor predicted by the lower construction, uniformly in exponent depth.
mechanisms.kill_test: Compute exact box optima before and after adjoining a coordinate for several prime sizes and E=1,2; kill if the ratio exceeds every proposed local factor.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Finite optimal fractional-cover duals converge to a scale-prime formula whose total mass has the prime-block order and covers every vertex exactly once up to a summable error.
mechanisms.kill_test: Fit candidate formulas on one N and replay all dual inequalities at larger N and on exponent boxes; kill on a negative slack or nonsummable fitted error.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Orienting each triple to its largest prime gives a bounded-congestion charging of every selected reciprocal weight to missing predecessors.
mechanisms.kill_test: Construct star-like families sharing the largest prime and compute exact congestion; kill if a single prime-scale bin receives unbounded harmonic load.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Every finite optimum admits an integral missing-vertex charge in which each excluded predecessor pays for all tight edges containing it with uniformly bounded load.
mechanisms.kill_test: Extract optimum sets and solve the secondary min-congestion assignment; kill when the minimum congestion grows across N or dilation depth.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: For every reciprocal-mass prime block, the predecessor constraint bounds its conditional partition function by the same factor achieved by the independent block construction.
mechanisms.kill_test: Enumerate correlated two-block squarefree patterns and exact cube optima; kill if conditional weighting exceeds the product of proposed block factors.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: After three available prime deletions, the at-most-two rule forces a fixed conditional entropy deficit that accumulates over reciprocal-mass blocks.
mechanisms.kill_test: Compute the deletion entropy for product measures, low layers, and MILP extremisers; kill if the deficit vanishes on an admissible family of growing dimension.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Tight primitive prime triangles can be selected on only a Carleson-packed set of dilation scales unless the selected set is close to a prime-block product construction.
mechanisms.kill_test: Build nested dilation adversaries and inspect exact H_N optima; kill if tight edges occupy arbitrarily many scales with no product structure.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: A weighted Carleson embedding for scaled prime triangles converts local at-most-two inequalities into a global harmonic bound of prime-block order.
mechanisms.kill_test: Evaluate the proposed embedding constant on all-g multiples of one primitive triangle and on overlapping prime triangles; kill on logarithmic divergence.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Near-optimal weighted independent sets have link-graph codegrees forcing closeness to a bounded-complexity prime-block partition.
mechanisms.kill_test: Compare link statistics of exact optima with deliberately mixed block constructions; kill if equally good sets have incompatible link profiles.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: A two-stage argument first tensorizes inside finite prime-exponent boxes and then charges primes and gcd scales outside the box with a summable boundary term.
mechanisms.kill_test: Quantify boundary mass as box dimension and exponent depth grow; kill if omitted primes or high exponents carry a nonvanishing fraction under an admissible adversary.
